decision_summary.text: The team has adopted a provisional plan to conduct a time-boxed, two-week discovery process with Northline to evaluate the feasibility of a reusable reporting layer, while explicitly avoiding production code commitments and simultaneously defining the scope of existing reliability and core-workflow commitments to enable a final, informed decision.

source_evidence.speaker: user
source_evidence.quote: My provisional plan is to offer Northline three focused sessions over the next two weeks, document the workflow, and explicitly make no build commitment. Lina can lead the sessions but not start production code. In the same period we will define the reliability work and the core-workflow release we are actually willing to promise. Then we decide with all three pieces visible. I still worry that “no production code” wastes Lina's best way of learning and that Northline will hear a polite no. But starting the build now feels less defensible than it did.
